title: Zesty Yeasty Turkish Portobello Mushrooms Doner Kebab
description: A yeasty, pillowy, brunch-mood Turkish dish featuring sherry vinegar and sashimi-cut portobello mushrooms, wrapped in pandan leaves.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine yeast and 1 tablespoon of warm water, stirring to dissolve.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, sherry vinegar, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sashimi-cut portobello mushrooms to the bowl and marinate for 10 minutes.
Add the dissolved yeast mixture to the mushrooms and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and set aside.
Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the marinated mushrooms.
Cook the mushrooms for 5 minutes per side, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
Brush the pandan leaves with olive oil and warm them in the microwave for 10 seconds.
Assemble the doner kebabs by placing a cooked mushroom on each pandan leaf, topping with crumbly feta cheese and a dollop of beaten egg.
